node-1.label: Bilateral scaly, thickened, erythematous eyelids with ectropic lower eyelids, crusty eyelid margin plaques, and diffuse conjunctival hyperemia

node-2.label: Patient is a 15-year-old boy with biopsy-proven Crohn disease, initially on infliximab then switched to adalimumab due to disease relapse

node-3.label: Physical examination showed bilateral scaly, thickened, erythematous upper and lower eyelids; both lower eyelids were ectropic; crusty plaques on eyelid margins; diffuse conjunctival hyperemia

node-4.label: Visual acuity was 20/20 OU and the rest of the ophthalmic examination was unremarkable

why.why: Pathologist analysis emphasizes that the dynamic pattern of lesions appearing during anti-TNF therapy and resolving after discontinuation favors a drug reaction over primary Crohn-associated eyelid inflammation. In addition, no eyelid biopsy was obtained, so non-caseating granuloma cannot be confirmed. These considerations lower confidence from 0.25 to 0.1.

Pathologist analysis identifies the clear temporal relationship—eyelid lesions appearing during TNF-α inhibitor treatment and resolving after discontinuation—as strong evidence for an anti-TNF-induced dermatologic reaction. Normal visual acuity and an otherwise unremarkable ocular examination exclude a vision-threatening process, while infectious eyelid disease and chronic blepharitis lack sufficient support. Therefore confidence is raised from 0.45 to 0.9.

Pathologist analysis states that infectious eyelid disease lacks sufficient support in this context. Although anti-TNF therapy increases infection risk, the strong temporal relationship with anti-TNF treatment and resolution after discontinuation points to a drug reaction rather than an infectious process. Confidence is lowered from 0.2 to 0.1.

Pathologist analysis finds chronic blepharitis/ocular rosacea lacks sufficient support. The crusty eyelid margin plaques and conjunctival hyperemia are nonspecific, and the strong temporal association with anti-TNF therapy makes a drug reaction much more likely. Confidence is lowered from 0.1 to 0.05.
